summary: Adjusts a texture material assignment. Validates the material name a1, a global condition via ConditionalDispatchWithGlobalCheck, and a successful texture-ID resolution via sub_548890; any failure returns -1. Then compares the resolved ID against up to three alternative texture paths a3, a4 and a5 using StringCompareCopy, returning 0, 1 or 2 for whichever matches first. When none match, copies each alternative into 253-byte local buffers seeded from byte_5EA438, formats a debug buffer through StringSplitLoop with the DDev string aDDevF119992002_5, logs an 'Unable to adjust texture' message via DebugLogWrite, and returns -1.

Return -1 when no alternative matched, otherwise 0, 1 or 2 for the matching alternative.
